{{Top|leg}}
An '''Imperial guard tower''' was located in the [[Shadow Town]] sector on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] network of security cameras throughout the sector was controlled from the guard tower.
